summary: This document explains how the experimental TCP option codepoints can serve several TCP extensions at once, even on one connection, using a new IANA TCP experiment identifier. It works with experiments that are not registered and those that do not use sharing. It is recommended for all new TCP options that use these codepoints.

eli5.summary: Several experiments share one mailbox, so each adds its own name tag to tell whose message is whose.

questions: shared use of experimental tcp options
